scope: The lifecycle tasks the landscape sweep's skills modality sweeps (tools/sota-convergence/landscape-sweep/README.md, Skills modality), the installed skills of adoption/skills/manifest.json that serve each task, and the skill sources it searches. Each task is one skills-* layer. Inclusion does not install, accept or authorize a skill; adoption/skills/manifest.json stays the only place a skill is pinned.
notes: 2026-10-08 amendment (docs/decisions/2026-10-08-skills-cc-lanes-picks.md): the three verified vendor pins serve existing tasks once each: hcom-agent-messaging and loki serve debugging, and promptfoo-evals serves skill-lifecycle evaluation. The task field named installed follows the central manifest's selected pins; this metadata addition performs no client installation. Host installation follows the PR's landing, as the decision records. The original catalog checked_at date is retained.
Each GitHub source's pin is its default-branch HEAD commit, read on 2026-09-30 with gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/commits/<default branch> (read-only). None of the sources was archived.

Each task's source_ids come from the SKILL.md folder names at those pins (gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/git/trees/<pin>?recursive=1), matched by task keyword and reviewed: product-scoped matches (Azure, Notion, Figma, trading) were dropped, and the registry and the curated list serve every task.

skills-sh-registry is searched with the manifest's pinned CLI, DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx skills@1.7.0 find <query> (vercel-labs/skills README.md at v1.7.0, lines 150 and 170-182). The registry has no commit, so its pin is the commit of the CLI's v1.7.0 tag.
openai-skills is the Codex curated skill source that developers.openai.com/codex/skills links (skills/.curated in github.com/openai/skills).

Maintenance was checked on 2026-09-30 for all 22 GitHub sources under the landscape sweep's common maintenance rule (templates.json common: stale when archived or with no commit on the default branch in the last 90 days, established with gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/commits?since=<date 90 days ago>&per_page=1, not from pushed_at): gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/commits?sha=<default branch>&since=2026-07-02T00:00:00Z&per_page=1. None is archived, and only openai-skills returned no commit, so it alone carries a maintenance record. Its four installed skills stay pinned and listed; the tasks they serve name the stale source as an open gap.
The manifest's excluded source 'various' (Lark/Feishu, Azure, genmedia and other vendor packs) names no single repository, so it is not a source here.

Microsoft's product-scoped skill repositories (azure-skills, skills-for-fabric, power-platform-skills, skills-for-copilot-studio, Dataverse-skills, win-dev-skills, aspire-skills, agent365-skills and others; gh api search 'skills in:name org:microsoft', 2026-09-30) are off-domain for these tasks; microsoft-skills is Microsoft's general skill repository.

alpacahq-alpaca-skills and vercel-labs-agent-skills serve no task: the paper-trading skills have the model submit orders, which deterministic code owns here, and the React/Vercel skills have no code here (the manifest's excluded reasons).
Install counts, registry rank and stars are discovery guides, never evidence of quality or fit.

The installed lists and open gaps follow adoption/skills/manifest.json as unit F3 (#553) left it on 2026-09-30: skill-creator is pinned and serves skills-skill-lifecycle, resolving-merge-conflicts is retired, every skill is listed on in Claude except the user-invocable-only grill-me and improve-codebase-architecture, and every skill but skill-creator is enabled in Codex. Each layer input carries the installed skills' claude_listing and codex_enabled from the manifest itself (build_inputs.py). On 2026-10-03 the wave-2 skills ruling retired grill-me, improve-codebase-architecture and semgrep (changes 1 and 3) and held agent-browser (change 6); the installed lists follow the manifest, and the design-intake task has no installed skill.

maintenance.evidence: REST default_branch=main and archived=false; gh api --cache 120s 'repos/openai/skills/commits?sha=main&since=2026-07-11T05:20:15Z&per_page=1' returned zero commits. The last main commit remains 49f948faa9258a0c61caceaf225e179651397431 at 2026-06-24T02:36:12Z, older than 90 days. pushed_at is not the maintenance test. The preregistered blinded native-validator diagnostic and the scoped maintenance re-rule are retained in evidence/artifacts/skills-trials-20261009/RESULT.json; static validation cannot establish a replacement skills repository.

tasks.requirement: Research first, before acting: survey maintained upstream tools, skills and prior decisions before writing code or adopting a component (the AGENTS.md research-first rule), with staged, bounded retrieval that keeps subagent context small.
tasks.overturn_when: A skill-creator paired with-skill/without-skill benchmark (or a promptfoo config) on a frozen set of research-first prompts from this repository's adopt-or-build decisions, in Claude Code and in Codex at equal model and effort, shows a candidate beating the installed skills' pass rate without a higher token or time cost; or an installed skill's upstream is archived, removed, relicensed or changes its invocation flags.

tasks.requirement: Run a skill's lifecycle end to end: discover (registry and source search), evaluate (source review at a pinned commit and audits), install (pinned through adoption/skills/manifest.json only), verify (listing and invocation on each host), A/B (a paired with-skill/without-skill comparison) and record (the manifest row and a decision record). Anything a registry search finds must still be pinned in the manifest before install.
open_gaps: skill-creator, a trial skill unit F3 (#553) pinned on 2026-09-30, covers authoring, evaluation and the paired with-skill/without-skill A/B in Claude; the manifest keeps it off in Codex (codex_enabled false), whose own .system/skill-creator is a different skill.
No pinned skill covers verify or record: none checks a skill's listing and invocation on each host, or writes or verifies a manifest row.
tasks.overturn_when: A skill-creator paired benchmark (or a promptfoo config) on a frozen skill-adoption walk-through (discover, evaluate at a pin, install through the manifest, verify the listing, A/B, record) shows a candidate completing more steps correctly than the current procedure at no higher token or time cost, in Claude Code and in Codex; or the pinned skills CLI changes its find or install behavior.

tasks.requirement: Interrogate requirements before building: stress-test an ambiguous request or plan (assumptions, open decisions, acceptance) before implementation starts. The skill must be model-invocable (no true-valued disable-model-invocation (true/yes/on/1) in SKILL.md and no allow_implicit_invocation: false in agents/openai.yaml), so a worker or the main session can run it without a user trigger, and it must not make intake, brainstorming or a planning approval mandatory for bounded work (AGENTS.md; the manifest's obra/superpowers exclusion).
open_gaps: No skill serves this task since 2026-10-03: the wave-2 skills ruling retired grill-me (change 1), which did nothing but call the excluded grilling skill, so the task waits for a candidate that passes the comparison below.
tasks.overturn_when: A skill-creator paired benchmark (or a promptfoo config) on frozen ambiguous-request and bounded-request prompts shows a model-invocable candidate asking the decisive questions on the ambiguous ones while adding no intake step to the bounded ones, in Claude Code and in Codex; or grill-me's upstream drops disable-model-invocation.

tasks.requirement: Improve codebase architecture: review a grown module and propose deeper modules and narrower interfaces, with a shared module/interface vocabulary for refactoring the large single-file validators (scripts/validate.py, scripts/landscape.py). The skill must be model-invocable (no true-valued disable-model-invocation (true/yes/on/1) in SKILL.md and no allow_implicit_invocation: false in agents/openai.yaml).
open_gaps: The wave-2 skills ruling retired improve-codebase-architecture on 2026-10-03 (change 1): it calls the excluded grilling and domain-modeling skills, so codebase-design alone serves this task.
tasks.overturn_when: A skill-creator paired benchmark (or a promptfoo config) on frozen refactor prompts over scripts/validate.py and scripts/landscape.py shows a model-invocable candidate producing accepted module and interface proposals more often than the installed pair at no higher token or time cost, in Claude Code and in Codex; or improve-codebase-architecture's upstream drops disable-model-invocation.

tasks.requirement: Implement changes with this repository's current tooling: Python scripts and tools on uv, ruff and pyproject conventions, and the generated HTML guide and dashboards, which are hand-styled today.
open_gaps: Both are trial skills (the trial window's review falls after 2026-10-25, the manifest's trial block).
tasks.overturn_when: A skill-creator paired benchmark (or a promptfoo config) on frozen Python and HTML change requests from this repository shows a candidate passing more of the repository's own tests and checks than the installed skill at no higher token or time cost, in Claude Code and in Codex; or an installed skill's upstream is archived, removed or relicensed.

tasks.requirement: Test first: new scripts land with unittest suites as the acceptance gate, and parsers and sanitizers (host_receipts.sanitize, the receipt validators) need property-based tests beyond their example tests (Scorecard's Fuzzing check scores 0).
open_gaps: property-based-testing sets effort: low in its frontmatter, which lowers a max-effort worker's turns after it loads (tools/sota-convergence/landscape-sweep/README.md, Model roles).
tasks.overturn_when: A skill-creator paired benchmark (or a promptfoo config) on frozen test-first tasks and parser/sanitizer property tests shows a candidate producing failing-first tests that catch more seeded defects than the installed skills at no higher token or time cost, in Claude Code and in Codex; or an installed skill's upstream changes its effort or invocation flags.

tasks.requirement: A debugging procedure for failing tests, CI checks and paper-engine faults, which are otherwise diagnosed ad hoc.
open_gaps: diagnosing-bugs is a trial skill; obra/superpowers systematic-debugging is excluded as a duplicate of it under the manifest's single-winner rule.
tasks.overturn_when: A skill-creator paired benchmark (or a promptfoo config) on frozen failing-test, CI-failure and engine-fault reproductions shows a candidate reaching the root cause more often than diagnosing-bugs at no higher token or time cost, in Claude Code and in Codex; or diagnosing-bugs' upstream is archived, removed or relicensed. For hcom-agent-messaging and loki, the scoped primary-source alternatives and task-specific overturn conditions are recorded in docs/decisions/2026-10-08-skills-cc-lanes-picks.md; native bootstrap/help or a wired operation route that fully covers the actual task replaces the additional skill listing.

tasks.requirement: Review evidence and changes before merge: typed semantic judgments for evidence review (the semantic-evidence-reviewer role) and a search for siblings of an already fixed defect before merge.
open_gaps: Native /code-review and /security-review cover diff review; the excluded mattpocock code-review failed its skills.sh audit (the manifest's excluded reason).
tasks.overturn_when: A skill-creator paired benchmark (or a promptfoo config) on frozen evidence-review tasks and fixed-defect variant tasks with known answers shows a candidate finding more true issues with fewer false ones than the installed skills at no higher token or time cost, in Claude Code and in Codex; or an installed skill's upstream is archived, removed or relicensed.

tasks.requirement: Security review with retained reasoning: secure-coding guidance for scripts/ and tools/, a threat model for the paper-lane broker adapters and credential stores, custom static rules and CodeQL alert triage, SARIF reading and diffing, dependency and agentic Actions risk audits, false-positive triage of Scorecard, zizmor and CodeQL alerts, and a whole-repository audit with a coverage ledger and a confirmed/needs_validation/rejected verdict contract.
open_gaps: security-audit is listed in Claude and enabled in Codex since 2026-09-30 (unit F3, #553), so the model may load it on an ordinary security question, where it is guidance only unless a prompt asks for the full audit; its M5c bake-off against /security-review decides its promotion (the manifest's security-audit row).

Stale source: replacement via this sweep. security-best-practices and security-threat-model come from openai/skills, which has had no main commit since 2026-06-24 (the openai-skills source's maintenance record).

The custom static rules have no owner since 2026-10-03: the wave-2 skills ruling retired the semgrep skill (change 3), whose plan-approval gate conflicts with the repository's rule against a separate planning approval for bounded work; codeql covers SAST for the languages it lists.
tasks.overturn_when: A skill-creator paired benchmark (or a promptfoo config) on frozen security-review tasks with known true and false positives shows a candidate with higher precision and recall than the installed skill it would replace at no higher token or time cost, in Claude Code and in Codex; or an installed skill's upstream is archived, removed, relicensed or fails a later audit.

tasks.requirement: CI and pull-request work: triage failing GitHub Actions checks across this repository's workflows and required checks, address PR review threads (the main ruleset requires their resolution), and resolve rebase conflicts on hot files (manifests/evidence.json, the docs/lanes.md hot-file protocol).
open_gaps: No installed skill resolves rebase conflicts: resolving-merge-conflicts was retired by unit F3 (#553) on 2026-09-30, after upstream removed it in daa01d8 (the manifest's excluded entry).
Stale source: replacement via this sweep. gh-fix-ci and gh-address-comments come from openai/skills, which has had no main commit since 2026-06-24 (the openai-skills source's maintenance record).
tasks.overturn_when: A skill-creator paired benchmark (or a promptfoo config) on frozen failing-check, review-thread and rebase-conflict tasks shows a candidate resolving more of them correctly than the installed skill at no higher token or time cost, in Claude Code and in Codex; or an installed skill's upstream is archived, removed or relicensed.

tasks.requirement: Maintain the agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md), which load into every Claude and Codex session and every worker that keeps project instructions: context load, a single source of truth and pruning of dated chronology. Skill authoring stays with skill-creator (skills-skill-lifecycle).
open_gaps: writing-for-agents' description also triggers on skill edits, a trial confound; only AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md uses count toward its gap (the manifest's writing-for-agents row).
tasks.overturn_when: A skill-creator paired benchmark (or a promptfoo config) on frozen AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md edit tasks shows a candidate producing smaller, single-source edits that keep every canonical rule, more often than writing-for-agents at no higher token or time cost, in Claude Code and in Codex; or writing-for-agents' upstream is archived, removed or relicensed.

tasks.requirement: Browser acceptance through the pinned agent-browser CLI (adoption/pins-*.json), with a skill that documents its commands for the pinned CLI version.
tasks.overturn_when: agent-browser fails a browser acceptance task that a candidate passes, measured with a skill-creator paired benchmark (or a promptfoo config) on frozen browser acceptance tasks against the pinned CLI, in Claude Code and in Codex; or the pinned agent-browser CLI stops shipping the skill.

tasks.requirement: Build or fix the MCP servers the stack wires (adoption/mcp and the files that reference MCP servers) with a written procedure.
tasks.overturn_when: A skill-creator paired benchmark (or a promptfoo config) on frozen MCP server build and fix tasks shows a candidate producing servers that pass their own tests and connect in Claude Code and Codex more often than mcp-builder at no higher token or time cost, in Claude Code and in Codex; or mcp-builder's upstream is archived, removed or relicensed.
